text:
maya: FYI customer Gamma asked for a custom safety-filtered model for launch next quarter. They need deterministic pinning and an SLA for P95 latency. Can we decide scope + rollout plan?
sam: quick q: is this a new model architecture or a filter wrapper on an existing variant?
maya: filter wrapper on rwd-3b-v2, plus a small post-filter classifier. Customer will be on Dedicated.
elena: main tradeoffs: latency overhead from post-filter, plus need for tenant pinning and per-tenant evals. we should scope MVP to "filter-as-config" not a brand new model.
prashant: technically feasible. estimated perf hit: ~12-18% token throughput for synchronous path. If we move filter to async scoring and shadowing, latency impact can be near-zero but increases complexity.
devon: Gamma insists on pinning to a specific model version and wants a rollback guarantee. they also want canary on 5 tenants first.
sam: proposal: ship config toggle that routes tenant requests through post-filter by default off. Launch plan: 1) Internal dogfood w/ shadow filtering 2) Canary (5 tenants, 1% traffic each) with filtering on 3) Ramp to 50% then 100% if metrics pass. pinning: tenant-level pin to filtered variant.
maya: acceptance criteria draft:
- AC1: Filtered variant available in model catalog and can be pinned per-tenant via console/API.
- AC2: End-to-end P95 latency increase <= 40ms on Dedicated baseline for 95% of requests (measured under the customer's profile).
- AC3: False positive rate of filter <= 1.5% on our internal eval set; false negative <= 0.5% on safety corpus.
- AC4: Canary abort conditions defined and automated: revert if safety regression OR latency delta > 2x SLA threshold OR error rate spike > 0.5% absolute.
- AC5: Rollback can be executed via tenant pin toggle in <5 minutes with audit log.
prashant: add AC for quality monitoring: we need a small prompt set (50 examples) per tenant for continuous regression detectors.
elena: experiment design notes:
- Canaries: start with tenant-scoped canary (5 tenants). Traffic split timeline: 1% per tenant for 24h -> 10% for 48h -> 50% for 72h -> full.
- Metrics to watch: safety alerts (automated classifier + manual QA sample), user-facing errors, P95 latency, token cost delta, throughput.
- Duration: minimum 7 days of steady-state at >=50% before considering full rollout.
sam: technical rollout guardrails:
- pinning: persistent tenant pin stored in config service; fallback policy to global default if pinned model not available.
- version compatibility: runtime will validate KV cache formats; if mismatch, block pin and auto-fallback.
- canary isolation: canary traffic goes to a separate capacity pool to avoid noisy neighbor effects.
devon: customer requirement: dedicated capacity SLA of 99.9% for production traffic. we need to confirm with infra whether the filtered path affects SLA.
sam: infra note: we can provision a dedicated pool for Gamma with autoscale margin + reserved burst. will need a ticket to infra with capacity numbers.
prashant: edge cases to call out in PRD:
- if classifier OOMs, route to unfiltered model and flag incident.
- if KV cache warms differently for filtered vs unfiltered, warm-up cold-starts for pinned tenants.
- model quantization mismatch: ensure filtered variant uses same quantization profile or declare as separate compatible variant.
maya: rollout abort/rollback criteria (short):
- immediate rollback if any safety metric regression confirmed by QA sample.
- rollback if P95 latency increase > 2x agreed SLA or error rate > +1% absolute for >1h.
- rollback if observed user complaints > threshold (ops-defined) or revenue-impacting errors.
elena: scope decision needed: do we include console UI for per-tenant pinning in MVP or rely on API only?
sam: we can do API-only for MVP and fast-follow console in week+1 post-launch.
maya: ok let's lock scope: MVP = API-based tenant pin + filter-as-config + canary infra + monitoring + rollback automation. UI postponed.
prashant: dev tasks I'm tracking: implement filter wrapper, add eval harness & prompt sets, telemetry hooks for safety signals.
sam: eng tasks: config service pinning, separate capacity pool plumbing, canary routing, fallback policies.
devon: customer comms: I'll draft an SOW with canary dates + rollback SLAs after infra confirmation.
ops-bot: ticket created: INFRA-4821 assigned to sam for dedicated pool provisioning.
maya: next steps: sam/prashant to estimate engineering effort by EOD Friday. elena to update PRD acceptance criteria and add the minimal experiment dashboard. devon to confirm customer canary tenant list.
sam: noted. will have rough estimates by Friday.
maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
